headline: Android 17 and Wear OS 7 roll out for Pixel devices, fixing key issues
summary: Google's stable Android 17 and Wear OS 7 updates are now available for compatible Pixel phones and watches, bringing crucial bug fixes and performance enhancements.
details: Google is rolling out the stable Android 17 and Wear OS 7 updates for compatible Pixel phones and watches. These releases pack several bug fixes and enhancements for a better user experience, improving performance and battery life.

For the Pixel 10 family, Android 17 addresses display-related issues like a white flickering dot and graphical glitches. Camera stability is also improved, with tweaks to reduce unwanted memory leaks.

This update, referred to as the June 2026 update, includes these bug fixes and improvements for Pixel users. Google has just started the rollout, so it may take some time to land on all compatible phones.
The Wear OS 7 update for Pixel Watches is lighter on features, with bigger changes expected later this year. However, it delivers several underlying bug fixes and usability improvements.

Key Wear OS 7 changes include a new gesture model for "Raise to Talk," designed to trigger Gemini more reliably. The Contacts app also receives a three-button layout and more Material 3 elements, such as larger contact photos for improved usability.
These Wear OS 7 enhancements are rolling out to the Pixel Watch 2, Watch 3, and Watch 4.
caption:
Google's Android 17 and Wear OS 7 updates are here for Pixel phones and watches! Expect significant fixes for battery drain, camera crashes, and display glitches.

Google is rolling out the stable Android 17 and Wear OS 7 updates for compatible Pixel phones and watches. These releases pack several bug fixes and enhancements for a better user experience, improving performance and battery life.

For the Pixel 10 family, Android 17 addresses display-related issues like a white flickering dot and graphical glitches. Camera stability is also improved, with tweaks to reduce unwanted memory leaks.

This update, referred to as the June 2026 update, includes these bug fixes and improvements for Pixel users. Google has just started the rollout, so it may take some time to land on all compatible phones.

The Wear OS 7 update for Pixel Watches is lighter on features, with bigger changes expected later this year. However, it delivers several underlying bug fixes and usability improvements.

Key Wear OS 7 changes include a new gesture model for "Raise to Talk," designed to trigger Gemini more reliably. The Contacts app also receives a three-button layout and more Material 3 elements, such as larger contact photos for improved usability.

These Wear OS 7 enhancements are rolling out to the Pixel Watch 2, Watch 3, and Watch 4.
